description_en: Queries the details of a specified delivery channel
description_zh: 查询指定投递渠道信息
name: GetConfigDeliveryChannel

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the delivery channel.

For more information about how to obtain the ID of a delivery channel, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/429841.html
parameters.help_zh:
投递渠道ID。

关于如何获取投递渠道ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/429841.html
parameters.name: delivery_channel_id

DeliveryChannel.description_en: The information about the delivery channel

AccountId.description_en: The ID of the current Alibaba Cloud account

CompliantSnapshot.description_en:
Indicates whether to deliver compliance snapshots. Cloud Config delivers compliance and non-compliance information of resources to SLS. Valid values:

true: Deliver compliance snapshots.

false: Do not deliver compliance snapshots
CompliantSnapshot.description_zh:
是否接收合规快照。配置审计向日志服务SLS投递资源合规和不合规信息。取值：
true：接收合规快照。
false：不接收合规快照

ConfigurationItemChangeNotification.description_en:
Indicates whether to deliver resource configuration changes. When the configuration of a resource changes, Cloud Config delivers the resource configuration changes to OSS, SLS, or MNS. Valid values:

true: Deliver resource configuration changes.

false: Do not deliver resource configuration changes
ConfigurationItemChangeNotification.description_zh:
是否接收资源配置变更历史。当资源配置变更时，配置审计向对象存储OSS、日志服务SLS或轻量消息队列（原 MNS）投递资源配置变更历史。取值：
true：接收资源配置变更历史。
false：不接收资源配置变更历史

ConfigurationSnapshot.description_en:
Indicates whether to deliver scheduled resource snapshots. Cloud Config delivers scheduled resource snapshots to OSS or SLS at `04:00Z` and `16:00Z` (UTC) every day. Valid values:

true: Deliver scheduled resource snapshots.

false: Do not deliver scheduled resource snapshots
ConfigurationSnapshot.description_zh:
是否接收资源定时快照。每天`04:00Z`和`16:00Z`（UTC时间），配置审计定时向对象存储OSS或SLS投递资源定时快照。取值：
true：接收资源定时快照。
false：不接收资源定时快照

DeliveryChannelAssumeRoleArn.description_en: The ARN of the role that is assumed by the delivery channel

DeliveryChannelCondition.description_en:
The rule that is attached to the delivery channel. This parameter is available only for delivery channels of the MNS type and for snapshot deliveries to delivery channels of the SLS type.

If you deliver data to an MNS topic, you can specify the lowest risk level of the events to subscribe to and the resource types to subscribe to.

The lowest risk level of the events to subscribe to: `{"filterType":"RuleRiskLevel","value":"1","multiple":false}`.

    The \`value\` parameter indicates the risk level. Valid values: 1 (high), 2 (medium), and 3 (low).

The resource types to subscribe to: `{"filterType":"ResourceType","values":["ACS::ACK::Cluster","ACS::ActionTrail::Trail","ACS::CBWP::CommonBandwidthPackage"],"multiple":true}`.

    The \`values\` parameter indicates the resource types. The value is a JSON array.
    Example:
    `[{"filterType":"ResourceType","values":["ACS::ActionTrail::Trail","ACS::CBWP::CommonBandwidthPackage","ACS::CDN::Domain","ACS::CEN::CenBandwidthPackage","ACS::CEN::CenInstance","ACS::CEN::Flowlog","ACS::DdosCoo::Instance"],"multiple":true}]`

If you deliver snapshots to an SLS Logstore, you can specify the resource types to deliver: `{"filterType":"ResourceType","values":["ACS::ACK::Cluster","ACS::ActionTrail::Trail","ACS::CBWP::CommonBandwidthPackage"],"multiple":true}`.

  The \`values\` parameter indicates the resource types. The value is a JSON array.
  Example:
  `[{"filterType":"ResourceType","values":["ACS::ActionTrail::Trail","ACS::CBWP::CommonBandwidthPackage","ACS::CDN::Domain","ACS::CEN::CenBandwidthPackage","ACS::CEN::CenInstance","ACS::CEN::Flowlog","ACS::DdosCoo::Instance"],"multiple":true}]`
DeliveryChannelCondition.description_zh:
投递渠道附加规则。当前支持MNS渠道的所有投递和SLS渠道的快照投递。

如果您指定MNS订阅事件的最低风险等级和资源类型，具体如下：

订阅事件的最低风险等级为`{"filterType":"RuleRiskLevel","value":"1","multiple":false}`。

     
    `value`表示您需要过滤的风险等级。取值：1表示高风险，2表示中风险，3表示低风险。

订阅事件的资源类型为`{"filterType":"ResourceType","values":["ACS::ACK::Cluster","ACS::ActionTrail::Trail","ACS::CBWP::CommonBandwidthPackage"],"multiple":true}`。
    
      
    `values`表示您需要订阅事件的资源类型，是一个资源类型的JSON数组。
    例如：
`[{"filterType":"ResourceType","values":["ACS::ActionTrail::Trail","ACS::CBWP::CommonBandwidthPackage","ACS::CDN::Domain","ACS::CEN::CenBandwidthPackage","ACS::CEN::CenInstance","ACS::CEN::Flowlog","ACS::DdosCoo::Instance"],"multiple":true}]`

如果您指定SLS快照投递的资源类型，资源类型为`{"filterType":"ResourceType","values":["ACS::ACK::Cluster","ACS::ActionTrail::Trail","ACS::CBWP::CommonBandwidthPackage"],"multiple":true}`。
    
      
    `values`表示您需要投递的资源类型，是一个资源类型的JSON数组。
    例如：
`[{"filterType":"ResourceType","values":["ACS::ActionTrail::Trail","ACS::CBWP::CommonBandwidthPackage","ACS::CDN::Domain","ACS::CEN::CenBandwidthPackage","ACS::CEN::CenInstance","ACS::CEN::Flowlog","ACS::DdosCoo::Instance"],"multiple":true}]`

DeliveryChannelId.description_en: The ID of the delivery channel

DeliveryChannelName.description_en: The name of the delivery channel

DeliveryChannelTargetArn.description_en:
The Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the delivery destination.

If the DeliveryChannelType parameter is set to OSS, this parameter is the ARN of the destination OSS bucket.

If the DeliveryChannelType parameter is set to MNS, this parameter is the ARN of the destination MNS topic.

If the DeliveryChannelType parameter is set to SLS, this parameter is the ARN of the destination Simple Log Service Logstore
DeliveryChannelTargetArn.description_zh:
投递渠道目标地址的ARN。

当DeliveryChannelType为OSS时，该参数为Bucket的ARN。

当DeliveryChannelType为MNS时，该参数为Topic的ARN。

当DeliveryChannelType为SLS时，该参数为Logstore的ARN

DeliveryChannelType.description_en:
The type of the delivery channel. Valid values:

OSS: Object Storage Service.

MNS: Simple Message Queue (formerly MNS).

SLS: Simple Log Service
DeliveryChannelType.description_zh:
投递渠道类型。取值：
OSS：对象存储。 
MNS：轻量消息队列（原 MNS）。
SLS：日志服务

DeliverySnapshotTime.description_en:
The time when Cloud Config starts to deliver scheduled resource snapshots every day.

The time is in the `HH:mmZ` format (UTC)
DeliverySnapshotTime.description_zh:
资源定时快照每日开始投递的时间。

格式为`HH:mmZ`（UTC时间）

Description.description_en: The description of the delivery channel

NonCompliantNotification.description_en:
Indicates whether to deliver resource non-compliance events. When a resource is evaluated as non-compliant, Cloud Config delivers the non-compliance events to SLS or MNS. Valid values:

true: Deliver resource non-compliance events.

false: Do not deliver resource non-compliance events
NonCompliantNotification.description_zh:
是否接收资源不合规事件。当资源不合规时，配置审计向日志服务SLS或轻量消息队列（原 MNS）投递资源不合规事件。取值： 
true：接收资源不合规事件。
false：不接收资源不合规事件

OversizedDataOSSTargetArn.description_en: The ARN of the OSS bucket to which the delivered data is transferred when the size of the data exceeds the limit of the delivery channel
OversizedDataOSSTargetArn.description_zh: 当投递数据超过投递渠道限制时，投递数据转存到对象存储OSS的目标存储空间

Status.description_en:
The status of the delivery channel. Valid values:

0: The delivery channel is disabled.

1: The delivery channel is enabled
Status.description_zh:
投递设置状态。取值：
0：关闭。
1：开启
